QUOTE: "`ExternalBridge::accept_loop` (`src/facade/external_bridge.cpp:796`, started by `ExternalBridge::start`) uses `poll()` with a 500ms timeout so it can see shutdown. Each accepted client gets its own thread, which is stored in `client_threads_` under `client_threads_mutex_`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer describes one accept thread (accept_loop) spawning a separate serve_client thread for each accepted client.
